alt: A difference array of zeros receiving a +v and a -v for each range update, then a running-sum pass over the difference array filling in the final array one entry at a time.

steps.caption: diff starts as 6 zeros, one entry longer than the array so diff[r + 1] always has room to write.
Update [0, 2] by 3: diff[0] += 3 starts it, diff[3] -= 3 stops it right after the range.
Update [1, 4] by 2: diff[1] += 2 starts it, diff[5] -= 2 stops it right after the range.
Update [3, 3] by 1: diff[3] += 1 starts it, diff[4] -= 1 stops it right after the range.
Every update is recorded. Now rebuild the array the same way M4.3's prefix sum runs over any array: a running total, left to right.
arr[0] = the running total after diff[0]: 0 + 3 = 3.
arr[1] = the running total after diff[1]: 3 + 2 = 5.
arr[2] = the running total after diff[2]: 5 + 0 = 5.
arr[3] = the running total after diff[3]: 5 + -2 = 3.
arr[4] = the running total after diff[4]: 3 + -1 = 2.
The running sum of diff is the final array: [3, 5, 5, 3, 2], every range update applied.
diff starts as 5 zeros, one entry longer than the array so diff[r + 1] always has room to write.
Update [0, 3] by 5: diff[0] += 5 starts it, diff[4] -= 5 stops it right after the range.
Every update is recorded. Now rebuild the array the same way M4.3's prefix sum runs over any array: a running total, left to right.
arr[0] = the running total after diff[0]: 0 + 5 = 5.
arr[1] = the running total after diff[1]: 5 + 0 = 5.
arr[2] = the running total after diff[2]: 5 + 0 = 5.
arr[3] = the running total after diff[3]: 5 + 0 = 5.
The running sum of diff is the final array: [5, 5, 5, 5], every range update applied.
